# ThePetHealthLab

> AI-powered, educational pet health and care platform. Free and premium tools to help pet parents make informed decisions — never a substitute for veterinary care.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform and featured tools.
- [Free Tools](/tools): Directory of free pet health and care tools.
- [Premium Tools](/premium): Advanced AI-powered tools for premium users.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Premium, Family and Pro plan details.
- [Blog](/blog): Research-backed articles on pet health, behavior and nutrition.
- [Community](/community): Peer support forum for pet parents.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): User dashboard for tracking pets and tools.
- [Login](/login): Sign in with Google or email.
- [Signup](/signup): Create an account with Google.

## Tools

- [Symptom Checker](/tools/symptom-checker): Educational AI symptom guide.
- [Toxic Food Scanner](/tools/toxic-food-scanner): Look up foods harmful to pets.
- [Calorie Calculator](/tools/calorie-calculator): Daily calorie estimates for pets.
- [Food Planner](/tools/food-planner): Portion and feeding planner.
- [Vaccine Scheduler](/tools/vaccine-scheduler): Track vaccinations and reminders.
- [Pet Cost Calculator](/tools/cost-calculator): Estimate pet care costs.
- [Expense Tracker](/tools/expense-tracker): Log and review pet spending.
- [Pet Behavior Solver](/tools/pet-behavior-problem-solver): Educational behavior guidance.
- [Lost Pet Poster](/tools/lost-pet-generator): Create lost pet posters and alerts.
